subject: Coupa vendor portal: account creation failing / onboarding kickoff
messages:
From: Riley Thompson <riley.thompson@acme-supplies.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement-admin@acme-supplies.com
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coupa vendor portal: account creation failing / onboarding kickoff

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier — excited to get Acme Supplies set up so Redwood can issue POs for the pilot. I tried to create a vendor account in your Coupa portal using the invitation link (looks like it was sent to procurement-admin@acme-supplies.com) but hit an error during account creation: "Unable to validate tax ID / account already exists" (screenshot attached).

We need to complete the vendor registration and PO/ACH setup by next week (targeting March 10) so billing and shipping lines up with the pilot start. Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood requires vendor registration in Coupa (or if you can create the vendor on our behalf)
- The list of docs you need (we can provide W-9, company registration, ACH letter)
- Any PO routing / remit-to details we should expect

I'm attaching the screenshot and can provide any additional forms immediately. Please advise next steps and who on your side will own vendor ops.

Thanks,
Riley Thompson
Procurement Lead, Acme Supplies Inc.
[riley.thompson@acme-supplies.com]

[Attachment: coupa-error-screenshot.png (image/png)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Riley Thompson <riley.thompson@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa vendor portal: account creation failing / onboarding kickoff

Hi Riley — thanks for the note and the screenshot. Short answer: yes, we use Coupa for PO issuance and vendor onboarding. We typically ask vendors to complete the Coupa registration so the vendor profile is paired to the correct admin contact and banking docs, but Procurement Ops can also create/merge the record if the portal shows a duplicate.

Next steps I'm initiating now:
1) Looping in our Procurement Ops (cc'd) to review the screenshot and check for an existing vendor record that might be blocking registration.
2) Please upload your W-9 and ACH/bank letter (PDFs) — we need those to complete tax and remit setup.
3) If you can confirm the exact admin email used to register (procurement-admin@acme-supplies.com?), that helps us find the duplicate.

I asked procurement to escalate if a merge or manual creation is needed; Marcus, Laura — can you take point on this and tell Riley whether we should (a) accept an invite we send from Coupa, or (b) create the vendor record on their behalf?

Riley — attaching the standard vendor onboarding checklist we send to external partners so you have the list of documents we typically request.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

[Attachment: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Riley Thompson <riley.thompson@acme-supplies.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa vendor portal: account creation failing / onboarding kickoff

Hi Riley — Laura from Procurement Ops here. Thanks for flagging this. I pulled the Coupa logs and it looks like there is a partially provisioned vendor record tied to an older admin email (acme.procure@oldvendor.com) which is why your registration attempt returned "account already exists."

What we'll do:
- We can either: (A) merge the partial record into a new record using procurement-admin@acme-supplies.com, or (B) create a fresh vendor profile and mark the existing one inactive.
- To proceed with merge/create we need:
  - Confirmed admin email for the active Coupa account (please confirm procurement-admin@acme-supplies.com)
  - Legal name and EIN (for tax validation) — a W-9 will suffice
  - ACH/bank letter or voided check for remit setup

If you prefer we create the record on your behalf, reply "Create on behalf" and we will generate the Coupa vendor ID and send you an acceptance link. If you prefer to finish registration yourselves after we clear the duplicate, reply "Invite me" and we'll send a fresh invite to procurement-admin@acme-supplies.com.

I've attached our onboarding checklist (same Jasmine sent) and will start a support case with Coupa if a backend merge is required.

- Laura Bennett
Procurement Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 510-555-0123

[Attachment: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]
